name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: Columns, sorting, row selection, pagination, and the three states a table spends most of its life in (loading / empty / error). It composes primitives — Checkbox, Pagination, Skeleton, Button — so it is a pattern, not a primitive.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/data-table

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/data-table.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/data-table';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/data-table
